final_message:
Fixed. The yen receipt now shows `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and added two decimals, but yen has no minor unit. I added a zero-decimal currency set, currently just `JPY`, and those currencies are now printed as-is.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) now format yen the same way. They had the same bug, and no tests cover yen there. Other currencies are unchanged.
